deliverables.label: About me and my role
deliverables.hint: Write 2–3 lines: who you are and what you will do in the team.

deliverables.label: Three problems I care about
deliverables.hint: Pick problems you have seen at school, at home or in your area.

deliverables.label: Our team rules
deliverables.hint: Who does what, and how we sort out disagreements.

deliverables.label: What our idea is
deliverables.hint: Two or three simple sentences.

deliverables.label: The problem, in one sentence
deliverables.hint: Who has the problem, and why is it annoying or costly for them?

deliverables.label: Our solution: a simple sketch
deliverables.hint: Draw it on paper and take a photo. Rough is fine.

deliverables.label: Idea slides (5–6 slides is fine)
deliverables.hint: Bonus: a first draft of slides about your idea.

deliverables.label: Who else solves this? Three examples
deliverables.hint: Include what people do today with no product at all, like asking a friend.

deliverables.label: Talk to 5 people and write what they said
deliverables.hint: Classmates, family or teachers. Write their words, not yours.

deliverables.label: What I learned from these talks
deliverables.hint: Did anything change in your thinking? Write a few lines.

deliverables.label: Quick idea test: a poll or sign-up sheet
deliverables.hint: Bonus: a Google Form or paper sheet is fine. Count how many say yes.

deliverables.label: Our product: what it is and does
deliverables.hint: One paragraph, simple words.

deliverables.label: Feature list: what we kept and what we cut
deliverables.hint: 3 to 5 lines. What you left out matters as much as what you kept.

deliverables.label: Show it to 3 people and write what they said
deliverables.hint: Classmates, friends or family. Note what they liked and what confused them.

deliverables.label: Product demo
deliverables.hint: Bonus: a photo or screenshot of your prototype is fine.

deliverables.label: Cost-to-build sheet
deliverables.hint: Bonus: time and money spent so far, even if it is ₹0.

deliverables.label: Our price: what we would charge and why
deliverables.hint: Compare with what people pay for similar things today.

deliverables.label: One person who says “I would buy this”
deliverables.hint: A classmate, teacher or family member. No money needed yet.

deliverables.label: One customer comment
deliverables.hint: Bonus: one sentence in their own words.

deliverables.label: A real sale
deliverables.hint: Bonus: if someone actually pays, any amount counts.

deliverables.label: Cost and price of one item
deliverables.hint: What does one item cost you, what do you sell it for, and what is left over?

deliverables.label: Comments from 3 people who tried it
deliverables.hint: Three different people, one sentence each, in their own words.

deliverables.label: Earn your first ₹500
deliverables.hint: Bonus: tick once you have earned this much from real customers.

deliverables.label: One-page summary of my idea
deliverables.hint: The problem, your solution, who it helps and what you learned.

deliverables.label: Pitch it in 3 minutes to someone
deliverables.hint: Practise with a friend, family member or teacher and ask for one tip.

deliverables.label: Enter one competition
deliverables.hint: Bonus: pick one from the Competitions tab, then tick this.
